7030 — Aishah reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
 “The blood of a Muslim who testifies that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is not lawful except in one of three cases: a man who commits adultery after being married, in which case he is stoned; a man who goes out fighting against Allah and His Messenger, in which case he is killed, crucified, or exiled from the land; or a person who kills another soul and is killed for it.”
In another narration:
 “A man who leaves Islam and wages war against Allah and His Messenger is killed.”
 Sahih: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4353), al-Nasa’i (4048), al-Daraqutni (3/81), and al-Hakim (4/367).

‘The blood of a man is not lawful except in the case of a man who apostatizes or leaves Islam, or commits adultery after being married, or kills a soul unlawfully.’”
 Hasan: Narrated by Ahmad (25477), al-Nasa’i (4017), and al-Tahawi in Mushkil al-Athar (1808).

٧٠٣٢ — عن عكرمة، قال: أُتي علي رضي اللّٰه عنه بزنادقة فأحرقهم، فبلغ ذلك ابن عباس فقال: لو كنت أنا لم أحرّقهم، لنهي رسول اللّه ﷺ: (( لا تعذبوا بعذاب اللّٰه )) ولقتلتهم لقول رسول اللّٰه ﷺ: (( من بدّل دينه فاقتلوه )).
صحيح: رواه البخاري (٦٩٢٢).

7032 — Ikrimah said: Apostates were brought to Ali may Allah be pleased with him and he burned them. News of that reached Ibn Abbas, who said: “Had it been me, I would not have burned them, because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade that, saying: ‘Do not punish with the punishment of Allah.’ Rather, I would have killed them because of the statement of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: ‘Whoever changes his religion, kill him.’”
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6922).

7033 — Abdullah ibn Abbas reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
 “Whoever changes his religion, kill him.”
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Nasa’i (4065), Ahmad (2966), authenticated by Ibn Hibban (4475), and al-Bayhaqi (8/202).

7034 — Abu Musa al-Ash‘ari said: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with two men from the Ash‘aris, one on my right and the other on my left, while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was using a tooth-stick. Both men asked for positions of authority. He said: “O Abu Musa,” or “O Abdullah ibn Qays.”
I said: “By the One who sent you with the truth, they did not tell me what was in their hearts, nor did I realize they were seeking leadership.”
It is as though I can still see his tooth-stick beneath his lip as it lifted. He then said: “We do not appoint to our affairs one who seeks it,” or “one who desires it. But go, O Abu Musa,” or “O Abdullah ibn Qays,” “to Yemen.”
Then he sent Mu‘adh ibn Jabal after him. When Mu‘adh arrived, Abu Musa offered him a cushion and said: “Sit.” There was a man tied up beside him. Mu‘adh asked: “What is this?” He said: “He was a Jew, then accepted Islam, then returned to Judaism.”
Mu‘adh said: “I will not sit until he is killed — the judgment of Allah and His Messenger,” repeating it three times. Then the man was ordered to be killed.
After that they discussed night prayer, and one of them said: “As for me, I pray and sleep, and I hope for reward in my sleep just as I hope for reward in my prayer.”
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6923) and Muslim (1733/15).

٧٠٣٧ — عن سعد بن أبي وقاص قال: لما كان يوم فتح مكة اختبأ عبد الله بن سعد بن أبي سرح عند عثمان بن عفان، فجاء به حتى أوقفه على النبي ﷺ فقال: يا رسول الله ﷺ، بايع عبد الله. فرفع رأسه فنظر إليه ثلاثا، كل ذلك يأبى. فبايعه بعد ثلاث، ثم أقبل على أصحابه فقال: (( أما كان فيكم رجل رشيد يقوم إلى هذا حيث رآني كففت يدي عن بيعته فيقتله )) فقالوا: ما ندري يا رسول اللّٰه ﷺ ما في نفسك، ألا أومأت إلينا بعينك! قال: (( إنه لا ينبغي لنبي أن تكون له خائنة الأعين)).

٧٠٣٨ — عن ابن عباس قال: كان رجل من الأنصار أسلم، ثم ارتد، ولحق بالشرك، ثم تندم، فأرسل إلى قومه: سلوا لي رسول اللّٰه ﷺ هل لي من توبة؟ فجاء قومه إلى رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فقالوا: إن فلانا قد ندم وأنه أمرنا أن نسألك: هل له من توبة؟ فنزلت: ( كَيْفَ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ قَوْمًا كَفَرُواْ بَعْدَ إِيمَانِهِم) - إلى قوله-(غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ) [آل عمران: ٨٦-٨٩]. فأرسل إليه فأسلم.
صحيح: رواه النسائي (٤٠٦٨) والحاكم (٣٦٦/٤).

7038 — Ibn Abbas said: A man from the Ansar accepted Islam, then apostatized and joined polytheism. Then he regretted it and sent word to his people: “Ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for me whether there is repentance for me.” His people came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “So-and-so has regretted what he did, and he has instructed us to ask you whether there is repentance for him.” Then the verse was revealed: “How shall Allah guide a people who disbelieved after their belief…” up to His saying, “Forgiving, Merciful.” [Surah Aal ‘Imran: 86–89] So he sent word to him, and the man accepted Islam again.
 Sahih: Narrated by al-Nasa’i (4068) and al-Hakim (4/366).

٧٠٣٩ — عن أنس، أن نفراً من عكل ثمانيةً، قدموا على رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فبايعوه على الإسلام فاستوخوا الأرض وسقمتْ أجسامُهم. فشكوا ذلك إلى رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فقال: (( ألا تخرجون مع راعينا في إبله فتصيبون من أبوالها وألبانها؟ )) فقالوا: بلى، فخرجوا فشربوا من أبوالها وألبانها فصحّوا. فقتلوا الراعي وطردوا الإبل. فبلغ ذلك رسول اللّٰه ﷺ فبعث في آثارهم. فأُدركوا فجيء بهم، فأمر بهم فقطعت أيديهم وأرجلهم وسُمرتْ أعينهم. ثم نبذوا في الشمس حتى ماتوا.
وفي رواية: فأمر بمسامير فأُحميت فكحلهم وقطع أيديهم وأرجلهم وما حسمهم، ثم أُلقوا في الحرّة يستسقون، فما سُقوا حتى ماتوا.
 قال أبو قلابة: سرقوا وقتلوا وحاربوا اللّٰه ورسوله.
 متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٦٨٠٤) ومسلم (١٠/١٦٧١). والسياق لمسلم.

7039 — Anas reported that eight men from Ukl came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and pledged allegiance to him upon Islam. They found the climate unhealthy and their bodies became ill, so they complained of that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said: “Why do you not go out with our shepherd among his camels and drink from their urine and milk?” They said: “Yes.” So they went out, drank from their urine and milk, and recovered. Then they killed the shepherd and drove away the camels. News of that reached the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he sent people after them. They were caught and brought back, and he ordered that their hands and feet be cut off and their eyes branded. Then they were left in the sun until they died.
In another narration: He ordered nails to be heated and used on their eyes; their hands and feet were cut off and the wounds were not cauterized. Then they were thrown into the rocky area, asking for water, but they were not given water until they died.
Abu Qilabah said: They stole, killed, and waged war against Allah and His Messenger.
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (6804) and Muslim (1671/10). The wording is that of Muslim.

٧٠٤٤ — عن ابن عباس أن أعمى كانت له أم ولد، كانت تشتم النبي ﷺ وتقع فيه، فينهاها فلا تنتهي، ويزجرها فلا تنزجر. قال: فلما كانت ذات ليلة جعلت تقع في النبي ﷺ وتشتمه، فأخذ المغول فوضعه في بطنها واتكأ عليها فقتلها، فوقع بين رجليها طفل، فلطخت ما هناك بالدم. فلما أصبح ذُكر ذلك لرسول اللّٰه ﷺ، فجمع الناس فقال: (( أنشد اللّٰه رجلاً فعل ما فعل، لي عليه حق إلا قام )). فقام الأعمى يتخطى الناس وهو يتزلزل حتى قعد بين يدي النبي ﷺ، فقال: يا رسول الله ﷺ، أنا صاحبها. كانت تشتمك وتقع فيك، فأنهاها فلا تنتهي، وأزجرها فلا تنزجر، ولي منها ابنان مثل اللؤلؤتين، وكانت بي رفيقة. فلما كان البارحة جعلت تشتمك وتقع فيك، فأخذت المغول فوضعته في بطنها واتكأت عليها حتى قتلتها. فقال النبي ﷺ: (( ألا اشهدوا أن دمها هدر )).
حسن: رواه أبو داود (٤٣٦١) والنسائي (٤٠٧٠) وابن أبي عاصم في الديات (٢٩٩)، والدار قطني (١١٢/٣).

7044 — Ibn Abbas reported that a blind man had a slave woman who had borne him children. She used to insult the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and speak abusively about him. He would forbid her, but she would not stop; he would rebuke her, but she would not desist. One night she began speaking abusively about the Prophet ﷺ and insulting him, so he took a short sword, placed it against her abdomen, and leaned upon it until he killed her. A child fell between her legs, and the area became stained with blood.
When morning came, the matter was mentioned to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He gathered the people and said: “I ask by Allah that the man who did what was done, and over whom I have a right, stand up.” The blind man stood, stepping over the people while trembling, until he sat before the Prophet ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I am the one who did it. She used to insult you and speak abusively about you. I would forbid her, but she would not stop; I would rebuke her, but she would not desist. I have two sons from her like two pearls, and she was kind to me. But last night she began insulting you and speaking abusively about you, so I took the short sword, placed it against her abdomen, and leaned upon it until I killed her.”
The Prophet ﷺ said: “Bear witness that her blood is unprotected.”
 Hasan: Narrated by Abu Dawud (4361), al-Nasa’i (4070), Ibn Abi Asim in al-Diyat (299), and al-Daraqutni (3/112).

٧٠٤٧ — عن أنس قال: كان رجل نصرانياً، فأسلم، وقرأ البقرة وآل عمران. فكان يكتب للنبي ﷺ فعاد نصرانيا فكان يقول: ما يدري محمد إلا ما كتبت له. فأماته اللّٰه فدفنوه. فأصبح وقد لفظته الأرض، فقالوا: هذا فعل محمد وأصحابه لما هرب منهم. نبشوا عن صاحبنا فألقوه فحفروه له فأعمقوا فأصبح وقد لفظته الأرض، فقالوا: هذا فعل محمد وأصحابه نبشوا عن صاحبنا لما هرب منهم فألقوه. فحفروا له، وأعمقوا له في الأرض ما استطاعوا. فأصبح وقد لفظته الأرض. فعلموا: أنه ليس من الناس فألقوه.
متفق عليه: رواه البخاري (٣٦١٧) ومسلم (٢٧٨١).
فقه هذا الباب:
كل من سب الرسول ﷺ أو افترى عليه لا بد أن يُقدَّم إلى الجهات المختصة، ولا يجوز لفرد أن يُقدِم على عمل إجرامي؛ فإن الإسلام يحرّم ذلك. ولكن يجوز للمسلمين أن يطالبوا، وخاصةً المجتمعات الغربية، بتجريم كل من يسيء إلى الدين الإسلامي، وإلى الرسول ﷺ، وإلى القرآن الكريم.
وقد أصدرت الأمم المتحدة قراراً يقضي باحترام جميع الأديان، ولكن وسائل الإعلام الغربية تتعمد الإساءة إلى الإسلام وحده دون غيره باسم «حرية التعبير»، بينما لا تستطيع أن تسيء إلى اليهودية. وقد تمت محاكمة عدد من الصحفيين والكتاب الذين تحدثوا عن «الهولوكوست»، وهي ازدواجية وكيل بمكيالين. ومع هذا كله فنحن المسلمين نؤكد للجميع بأن الإسلام دين المحبة والسلام والرحمة والهداية، وأن احترام جميع الأنبياء والرسل جزء من إيماننا، وأن الذين يقومون بعمل إجرامي لا يقبله الإسلام ولا يمثلون المسلمين، ولكن لا تبيح «حرية التعبير» إيذاء شعور الآخرين في معتقداتهم.

7047 — Anas said: There was a Christian man who accepted Islam and recited al-Baqarah and Aal ‘Imran. He used to write for the Prophet ﷺ. Then he returned to Christianity and would say: “Muhammad knows nothing except what I wrote for him.” Allah caused him to die, and they buried him. In the morning, the earth had cast him out. They said: “This is the work of Muhammad and his companions. When he fled from them, they dug up our companion and threw him out.” So they dug a deeper grave for him. In the morning, the earth had cast him out again. They said: “This is the work of Muhammad and his companions. They dug up our companion when he fled from them and threw him out.” So they dug for him and made the grave as deep as they could. In the morning, the earth had cast him out again. Then they knew that this was not from people, so they left him.
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (3617) and Muslim (2781).
Jurisprudence of this chapter:
Anyone who insults the Messenger ﷺ or fabricates lies against him must be referred to the proper authority; no individual may take criminal action on their own, for Islam forbids that. However, Muslims may demand, especially from Western societies, that anyone who insults the Islamic religion, the Messenger ﷺ, or the Noble Qur’an be criminalized.
The United Nations has issued a resolution requiring respect for all religions, but Western media deliberately insults Islam alone under the name of “freedom of expression,” while it is unable to insult Judaism. A number of journalists and writers who spoke about the “Holocaust” have been prosecuted, which is a double standard and unequal measure. Despite all of this, we Muslims affirm to everyone that Islam is a religion of love, peace, mercy, and guidance; that respecting all prophets and messengers is part of our faith; and that those who commit criminal acts are not accepted by Islam and do not represent Muslims. But “freedom of expression” does not permit hurting the feelings of others regarding their beliefs.

7047 — Anas said: There was a Christian man who accepted Islam and recited al-Baqarah and Aal ‘Imran. He used to write for the Prophet ﷺ. Then he returned to Christianity and would say: “Muhammad knows nothing except what I wrote for him.” Allah caused him to die, and they buried him. In the morning, the earth had cast him out. They said: “This is the work of Muhammad and his companions. When he fled from them, they dug up our companion and threw him out.” So they dug a deeper grave for him. In the morning, the earth had cast him out again. They said: “This is the work of Muhammad and his companions. They dug up our companion when he fled from them and threw him out.” So they dug for him and made the grave as deep as they could. In the morning, the earth had cast him out again. Then they knew that this was not from people, so they left him.
 Agreed upon: Narrated by al-Bukhari (3617) and Muslim (2781).
Jurisprudence of this chapter:
Anyone who insults the Messenger ﷺ or fabricates lies against him must be referred to the proper authority; no individual may take criminal action on their own, for Islam forbids that. However, Muslims may demand, especially from Western societies, that anyone who insults the Islamic religion, the Messenger ﷺ, or the Noble Qur’an be criminalized.
The United Nations has issued a resolution requiring respect for all religions, but Western media deliberately insults Islam alone under the name of “freedom of expression,” while it is unable to insult Judaism. A number of journalists and writers who spoke about the “Holocaust” have been prosecuted, which is a double standard and unequal measure. Despite all of this, we Muslims affirm to everyone that Islam is a religion of love, peace, mercy, and guidance; that respecting all prophets and messengers is part of our faith; and that those who commit criminal acts are not accepted by Islam and do not represent Muslims. But “freedom of expression” does not permit hurting the feelings of others regarding their beliefs.
